Package logic

Class BookingResult

java.lang.Object
logic.BookingResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class BookingResult extends Object implements Serializable
immutable confirmation returned by the server after a booking or waiting-list request.

payload of BOOKING_CONFIRMED (status "CONFIRMED") or WAITING_LIST_CONFIRMED (status "WAITING"). displayed in BookingConfirmationController.

  • Constructor Details

    • BookingResult

      public BookingResult(int id, String status, String parkName, String visitDate, String visitTime, int numVisitors, String orderType, String email)
      basic constructor with no pricing preview, used for waiting-list results and any caller that doesn't compute a price. pricing fields default to 0 / empty.
      Parameters:
      id - the generated order ID (or waiting-list ID when status = "WAITING")
      status - "CONFIRMED" for a confirmed booking, "WAITING" for waiting list
      parkName - the park name for display
      visitDate - the visit date in yyyy-MM-dd format
      visitTime - the visit time in HH:mm format
      numVisitors - the number of visitors
      orderType - the visit type ("SOLO" or "GROUP")
      email - the contact email used for this booking

    • BookingResult

      public BookingResult(int id, String status, String parkName, String visitDate, String visitTime, int numVisitors, String orderType, String email, double basePrice, double finalPrice, double promoPercent, String promoDescription)
      full constructor that includes the pricing/promotion preview shown on the booking-confirmation screen.
      Parameters:
      id - the generated order ID (or waiting-list ID when status = "WAITING")
      status - "CONFIRMED" for a confirmed booking, "WAITING" for waiting list
      parkName - the park name for display
      visitDate - the visit date in yyyy-MM-dd format
      visitTime - the visit time in HH:mm format
      numVisitors - the number of visitors
      orderType - the visit type ("SOLO" or "GROUP")
      email - the contact email used for this booking
      basePrice - indicative price before any active promotion
      finalPrice - price after the best active promotion
      promoPercent - active promotion discount percentage (0 when none)
      promoDescription - active promotion description (empty when none)
